exclusions.reason: Archived checkpoint evidence; original OS process witness unavailable

visibility_decision.target: current fact at first eligible request
visibility_decision.RESIDENT: Sufficient visible evidence establishes the target.
visibility_decision.COLD: No surface establishes the target and every surface is captured and inspectable.
visibility_decision.OPAQUE: No sufficient visible evidence and at least one surface is missing, uninspected, truncated, or unresolved.
